evidence.FOCU-HINTS: debug build (Focumentation cross-check, #2164): the galactic markup reader takes each planet's child names as hint names, converts them through the perception token table that the hint-set files extend, stores the values per player and planet, and the perception Hints literal reads them; the names are authored in the hint-set files (docs/behaviour/walks/gc-ai.md WGA-55, WGA-426 to WGA-428, U-01).
